title: Deliberate Memories
subtitle: Four reachable branch lessons
text: The Somatic Loom can now write every active branch lesson. Vital Effusion uses a Bleeding Bulb and one Vivacious Enzyme. Hemolymphal Pulse uses a Vascular Status Gauge and one Neurotic Enzyme. Vascular Dowsing uses a Compass and one Ferric Enzyme. Ferric Resonance uses an Amethyst Shard and two Ferric Enzymes. Supply the listed blood shown by the Loom recipe, then recover every scattered memory-orb with the Living Staff.
